risk_summary: The excerpt is generally constructive and quantitatively supported, citing budget growth, revenue cost percentages, backlog, and goodwill concentrations. Key risks include continuing resolutions, procurement delays, pricing pressure, labor and clearance constraints, COVID-19 effects, acquisition-related debt and amortization, and reliance on subjective impairment assumptions. Disclosure is moderately complex and uses standard forward-looking and uncertainty language, but is not highly evasive.
